sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: A character's social origin and the official feature tied to that origin.
When: Use at character creation and when a PC's upbringing explains what they know, fear, or notice.
Not When: Do not make community the only path to a clue; it should add texture or a cleaner route.
Answer: Use the printed community feature and let the background shape how the same clue is discovered.
Example: A Highborne PC may recognize legal polish in a contract faster; an Underborne PC may notice who is absent from the paperwork.

Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
